credit: El Reno Survey Project; Tim Marshall camera track.
method: Published UTC timestamps, latitude, longitude and camera 1 azimuth. Directions are shown clockwise from north, following the source viewer. Camera positions are not interpolated.
limits: The marker shows the latest preceding recorded camera location for at most 90 seconds, then disappears. This is a display rule, not a measured error bound. Location and clock uncertainty are not quantified for these samples. The El Reno Survey paper says view directions were estimated to a precision of plus or minus 10 degrees from road orientations and landscape features. That is a method value, not a measured error for any one sample. The arrow has no distance or field-of-view meaning. No photograph or video frame is assigned to this track here.
